item.title: Contratto di ricerca: COMPETITION FOR N.1 RESEARCH CONTRACT, GROUP 01/MATH-03 MATHEMATICAL ANALYSIS, PROBABILITY AND MATHEMATICAL STATISTICS AT BIDSA RESEARCH CENTER AT UNIVERSITÀ COMMERCIALE “LUIGI BOCCONI” DI MILANO (Univ. Bocconi MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-27 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-03 Analisi matematica, probabilità e statistica matematica

The research is part of the ERC MIND project (GA 101219635) and aims to advance the mathematical theory of turbulence in incompressible fluids. It focuses on partial differential equation (PDE) models, particularly the Euler and Navier–Stokes equations, in the low-regularity regimes typical of turbulent flows. The goal is to provide a rigorous, quantitative description of phenomena observed in experiments and simulations and predicted by phenomenological theories, such as Kolmogorov’s K41 theory and Onsager’s ideal turbulence. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: The ubiquity of logarithmically correlated fields (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-15 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma, Rm
Field: Mathematics and computer science / 01/MATH-04 Fisica matematica

In 2012 Fyodorov, Hiary, and Keating formulated a striking conjecture: the maxima of log-determinants of large random matrices behave like those of logarithmically correlated fields. Surprisingly, they conjectured that also the Riemann zeta function belongs to this log-correlated group. While there has been huge progress in proving this conjecture, most of the current results are for integrable models. The goal of this project is to establish new analytical techniques to show that this connection holds for a large class of random matrix models, and more. PERSONAE will develop language technologies that are accessible and adaptable to individual preferences. The project will establish personal NLP, moving beyond the idea of a single correct answer for subjective tasks such as abusive language detection and sentiment and emotion analysis. It will create datasets, tasks, and privacy conscious algorithms that users can customize over time. The selected candidates will help develop models, design experiments, analyze data, curate annotated datasets, and write research papers.
